ideas.title: Trim offline A-Life simulation radius
ideas.hypothesis: Most CPU cost in Zaton comes from offline squads far outside the player's awareness radius; shrinking it should raise 1% lows.
ideas.measure: fps_1pct_low and frametime_p99_ms over a 5 minute Zaton walk
ideas.notes: Watch for squads popping in at the edge of the trimmed radius.

ideas.title: Drop sun shadow cascade count to 3
ideas.hypothesis: The fourth cascade costs frametime but is barely visible at GAMMA's default draw distance.
ideas.measure: fps_avg and frametime_p99_ms on the Rostok bar loop
